walkthrough: Goal: change the colours of something already painted (shift its hue, take its saturation away, darken it, bend its tones with a curve), see each change on the canvas while setting it, keep it or drop it, limit it to a selection or to the layer's mask, take it back and find it again after reopening.

Entry: on an empty library (2880 x 1800, landscape) choose a blue in the colour panel, widen the brush with the side bar's size slider and paint a solid blue block on Layer 1. In the left island, after Actions, the wand (Adjustments, Procreate's place) opens a popover headed Adjustments with two rows: Hue, Saturation, Brightness and Curves.

Hue, Saturation, Brightness: tapping the row closes the menu; a panel grows from the wand (it keeps the ink ring) headed Hue, Saturation, Brightness with three sliders, each at 50 % (no change), then Reset (grey), Cancel and Apply. Dragging Hue to the right turns the block's colour round the colour circle as the hand moves, the knob under the hand; Brightness to the left darkens it. The fingers still move the view; the pen draws nothing while the panel shows.

Apply: tapping Apply keeps the block as it shows, as one step: the panel goes back into the wand; one undo gives the blue block back, redo the adjusted one. Tapping the wand while adjusting applies too, and so does choosing any other tool or edit.

Curves: the panel holds Gamma, Red, Green and Blue (Gamma in the ink pill) over a square with the curve as a straight ink line. Choosing Red and dragging from the middle of the line upward adds a point and lifts the red tones; the canvas follows. Cancel drops it all: the panel goes and the block is as it was. Curves again, Gamma, the middle dragged down darkens the middle tones; Apply keeps it.
Selection: with a rectangle selected over the block's left half, Hue, Saturation, Brightness with Saturation at 0 turns only the selected half grey; the selection stays after Apply.

Mask: with the layer's mask added (Layers, Add Mask) and the selection gone, Brightness at a quarter darkens the white mask to grey, so the whole layer shows at half; the mask holds the change, the paint is untouched.

Refusal: with the layer hidden, choosing an adjustment says Can't adjust: the layer is hidden. with OK, and no panel opens. Reopen after the system closed the app: every applied adjustment shows as it was applied.
Not here: Gaussian blur, sharpen and the other Procreate adjustments, Pencil mode, removing curve points (Reset clears the curve shown).
